name: HoloNet
description: The HoloNet links garrison trackers. Lets troopers link their accounts on other garrisons' trackers, so their service record shows every troop they have done on any linked tracker.
author: Obsidian Slicers

settings.label: Tracker name
settings.help: How this tracker is named to troopers on other trackers, for example 501st Florida Garrison. Leave empty to use the site name.

settings.label: Let troopers share their history with other trackers
settings.help: When off, troopers can still link other trackers here, but other trackers can't read troop history from this one.

settings.label: Tracker list URL
settings.help: Where the list of supported trackers is read from. Leave empty to use the list in the TroopTracker repository.
